blender.lts: 5.2 LTS (released 2026-07-14, maintained until July 2028); 4.5 LTS supported until July 2027
blender.python: 3.13 (3.13.13 in the 5.2 build recipe; bpy wheel requires CPython 3.13)

routes.name: bpy as Python module driven from Rust via PyO3
routes.licence: GPL-3.0 (bpy wheel); whole Rust app must be GPL-compatible
routes.speed: Render speed equals Blender; scene sync copies through Python objects; 210-403 MB wheel
routes.stability: Python threads unsupported; calls from one thread; CPython 3.13 only; one .blend at a time
routes.addons: Python-only add-ons in same interpreter; UI add-ons not shown (per-add-on UNVERIFIED)

routes.name: Blender headless child process over IPC
routes.licence: Separate GPL program; likely aggregation if communication is simple, grey area if complex scene data is shared (legal opinion, not advice)
routes.speed: Full Blender start-up; scene updates cross a pipe or socket
routes.stability: Crash isolation; child crash does not kill the app
routes.addons: Closest to full add-on compatibility inside that Blender

routes.name: Standalone Cycles (Apache-2.0) linked via C++ FFI (cxx) with a thin wrapper
routes.licence: Apache-2.0 plus dependency licences (Apache-2.0, BSD-3, Tomorrow Open Source Technology License 1.0, MIT)
routes.speed: Same path-tracing code as Blender; direct memory access; live Session reset and DisplayDriver
routes.stability: Own app, Hydra delegate and tests; no stable public API promise found; v4.0.0 to v5.2.0 had 426 commits in src/scene, 44 in src/session, 59 in src/hydra; pin a version
routes.effort: High at start (C++ wrapper, ~10 library build), low after; no existing Rust bindings found; no in-process Rust embedding found on GitHub (only Blender sidecar tools)
routes.addons: None; Blender add-ons, Geometry Nodes and importers are lost

routes.name: Fork of Blender with Rust UI replacing Blender UI
routes.licence: GPL (v2+ source, v3+ binaries); whole product GPL
routes.speed: Best raw reuse of Blender internals
routes.effort: Very high (Blender repo about 112.5 MB of C++ source by GitHub language bytes, vs about 5 MB for Cycles)
routes.addons: Most add-ons if Blender Python API kept; UI-bound add-ons lost

options.cons: No 10M-50M-triangle wgpu benchmark found (UNVERIFIED); closest: Bevy meshlets 2.78 ms GPU on RTX 3080 for a 3092-bunny scene (LOD-culled); mesh shaders experimental; extra layer overhead

options.name: Custom DAG + rayon 1.12.0
options.pros: Lazy pull-based eval, per-modifier cache, exact control
options.cons: Cache invalidation bugs are ours

stack.pick: Custom dependency graph with lazy rayon evaluation and per-modifier cache

options.name: Command pattern (undo 0.52.0)

options.name: Persistent structures (imbl 7.0.2 / rpds 1.2.1)

options.name: Snapshot diff
options.cons: Slow and large for big meshes

stack.pick: Persistent scene state with copy-on-write Arc mesh buffers
stack.why: Unlimited cheap steps, and an immutable snapshot lets autosave run on a worker thread without locks.

options.name: abi_stable 0.11.3 / stabby 72.1.16

stack.pick: Embedded Python via PyO3 for scripting; versioned C ABI for native plugins; Wasm later for untrusted plugins
